answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 905 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ocean. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the ripple queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The anchor index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 31 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
